content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Clinical Research Coordinator at a Glance

rows.details: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS), Lucknow
A randomized, double blind, multicenter, placebo-controlled phase 3 study with open label period to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Inebilizumab in adults with myasthenia gravis
No application fee / No IA/DA will be given

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Life Science/Clinical Research with experience in Clinical Trial and Computer.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position offers a consolidated emolument of Rs. 20,000.00 for a temporary duration of approximately 1 year. Accommodation is not provided in the campus.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGPGIMS Clinical Research Coordinator
content_sections.text: Prepare your current biodata. Include your personal WhatsApp number in the biodata. Gather self-attested testimonials supporting your qualifications and experience. Send the biodata along with the WhatsApp number and self-attested testimonials by email to [email protected] latest by 16 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview. Candidates will be intimated by email regarding the interview. No separate admit card will be issued, and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The interview is scheduled for 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Clinical Research Coordinator position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary for approximately 1 year, and accommodation is not provided in the campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold an M.Sc. in Life Science/Clinical Research with experience in Clinical Trial and Computer.

faq.question: Q3. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: You must submit your application by email by sending your current biodata along with a personal WhatsApp number and self-attested testimonials to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply and when is the interview?
faq.answer: The last date to apply by email is 16 October 2026, and the interview is scheduled to take place on 19 October 2026.
